note.text: Delivered the first source-level isolated app-server adapter slice in signed commit fba4d92f0fb0fda08f1f17de9a5798a66368ded6. It prepares an atomic Tiber-owned Codex home, pins Codex 0.147.0, delegates status/browser login/API-key login/logout, streams text, rejects every server-requested effect, returns correlated dynamic tools as inert typed data, removes ambient provider credentials, bounds deadlines/queues/envelopes, sanitizes credential errors, and reaps the child. Deterministic process tests, just tiber-harness-rust, post-commit just ci, and independent protocol/process/testing reviews are clean. Pushed GitHub CI run 31554538446 completed success. The slice is explicitly not yet release-packaged; TUI and durable conversation state remain.
